headline: Pacific Blue Cross says a cyber incident took down its website and contact centre; it has not said if it was an attack or data was taken.
summary: New incident page. CBC (s001, read as carried in full by Yahoo News Canada, s002; CBC's own page blocked) and Vista Radio's My Prince George Now (s003) each report the company's statements: a "cyber incident" first noticed early Nov 25 disrupted some systems; website and contact centre unavailable; contained, restoring securely with external specialists; members to keep claims and receipts; no restoration estimate; no word on cause or personal data. A member told Vista Radio they paid cash for prescriptions. Main answer Not established, filed under unclear: the company has not said whether anyone got in. incident_type outage; service down (c002, Reported). Size Regional.
